answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Reaching the lotus of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The signal lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the mirror is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
